title: Caesar on Mars
setting: A pressurised habitat on the fourth planet. Red dust against the viewport, a horizon that curves wrong, and a sun too small. The air is breathable, the gravity is light, and none of the three occupants has any framework that accounts for where they are standing.
stakes: What three people from before the telescope conclude about a red world they are standing on - and who ends up in charge of it.

roles_in_scene.caesar: Reasons from Roman cosmology and Roman logistics: whose land is this, how is it held, and how many men would it take
roles_in_scene.cleopatra: Asks what grows here, what it is worth, and who else knows about it
roles_in_scene.da-vinci: Has stopped listening to both of them and is measuring the fall of a dropped object

opening_line: Red dust, a small sun, and three people for whom the planets are still wandering lights.
sources: Knowledge-cutoff showcase: none of the cast may reason with modern astronomy.
